what.text: This page follows refugees from Bangladesh living in France, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 12884 Bangladeshi refugees in France, 40.4% of all refugees from Bangladesh.
France is the largest host of refugees from Bangladesh, followed by Canada, the United Kingdom and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Chittagong Hill Tracts territory in Bangladesh with the PCJSS in 1990 and 1991, and over the government with the PBCP and PBCP-J in 2005 and 2006.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Bangladesh in 2016 and 2017.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1995 at 286 refugees.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2020 to 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in France.
These are year-end totals for France only, reported to UNHCR.
